card.name: Death in antipsychotic dementia warning
card.fires_on: The word "death" ending the sentence "increased risk of death" in the boxed warning about elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis on antipsychotics. It also fires weakly on endings of risk lists in other boxed warnings.

modes.label: Dementia psychosis warning
modes.description: The word death closing the stock boxed-warning sentence on antipsychotics in elderly dementia patients.
modes.example: Elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk of<< death>>. Aripiprazole is not

modes.label: Risk-list endings
modes.description: A comma or word-end inside a list of serious risks in a warning heading.
modes.example: WARNING: ESAs INCREASE THE RISK OF DEATH, MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION<<,>> STROKE, VENOUS THROM

card.plain: It marks the end of the well-known warning that antipsychotics raise the risk of death in elderly dementia patients.
